posts.zh:
dsh-human-task 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。人工协作工具（`human_task` / `human_task_ready_check`）：让 Agent 暂停等待用户完成现实操作或返回观察结果（GUI 操作、游戏测试、视觉验证、硬件检查等），内置会话同意与 AFK 在场两级门控，通过 Web 任务窗返回结构化 JSON 结果。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-982a76fee923318629d8.html
posts.en:
dsh-human-task is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Human-in-the-loop tools (`human_task` / `human_task_ready_check`): pause the agent until the user performs a real-world action or returns an observation (GUI operation, game testing, visual verification, hardware checks), gated by session consent and an AFK presence check, returning a structured JSON result via a web task dialog.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-982a76fee923318629d8.html
